messages:
Ben (marketing): quick idea — run a small PLG micro-experiment: 200 starter credits + 2 curated prompt templates in the welcome email. measure: first-session token usage, 24h DAU lift, and 7d paid-conversion. target = +20% first-session tokens. thoughts? :thinking_face:
Ava (growth): love it. suggest 2 cohorts: (A) credits only, (B) credits + templates + nudge email at 6h. keep sample = 2k new signups each cohort? :bar_chart:
Carlos (content): i can draft 6 short prompt templates (chat intro, summarizer, brainstorm, code helper, email writer, product copy). will keep them <120 chars each so they fit the template UI. sample copy incoming.
Zoe (events): can we tie a 20-min "starter" webinar 48h after signup for cohort B? low-effort, helps convert. also offer a demo time slot in the email. :calendar:
Priya (ops): routing note — when a user redeems starter credits and runs >100 tokens in session, tag them credit-activated and route to inbound-sdr queue via webhook. i need the SDR queue tag + confirm payload schema.
Ben (marketing): @Priya yes, routing rule = tag:credit-activated, source:starter-credit-campaign, priority:normal. send webhook to /hooks/sdr-ingest with payload {user_id, email, tag, first_redeem_ts}. (Priya can you verify?)
Priya (ops): ack. will create a small lambda and a dead-letter topic. ETA EOD tomorrow. also adding rate limits so SDR doesn't get flooded.
Eve (analytics): what exact metrics to track in dashboard? propose: first_session_token_count, sessions_24h_active, pct_with_prompt_call, 7d_paid_conversion, avg_cost_per_acquisition. i'll add cohort breakdown and retention curve.
Ava (growth): nice. add dollar LTV estimate for the 7-day converters so we can compare to credit cost.
Carlos (content): draft of prompt templates: 1) "Summarize this article in 3 bullets." 2) "Generate 5 product feature ideas for [topic]." 3) "Draft a concise user-facing email about [feature]." — keeping placeholders to personalize. posting full copy in #content-drafts.
Ben (marketing): email snippet draft:
```
Welcome — here are 200 starter credits to try Redwood Inference.
Use these curated prompts to get going, or jump into the playground.
[Use credits] [Register for 20-min starter webinar]
```
Add UTM params: ?utm_campaign=starter_credit_experiment&utm_source=email
Zoe (events): webinar registration page ready. i recommend 2 slots (Wed/Thu) and a follow-up reminder at 1hr. can we include an incentivized CTA for attendees to redeem an extra 100 credits if they attend?
Ava (growth): careful with extra credits — might confound results. maybe do the extra credits only for an opt-in live demo path (separate). keep the core experiment clean.
Ben (marketing): good call. no extra credits for the main experiment. reserve incentive for a second test.
launch-bot: Reminder: landing page update for starter campaign deployed to staging at 11:50. :rocket:
Priya (ops): routing playbook draft: 1) first redeem -> tag credit-activated. 2) if >100 tokens in first session -> immediate inbound-sdr webhook. 3) if user attends webinar -> add attendee tag. will push infra PR after lambda created.
Eve (analytics): i'll instrument feature flags so we can switch cohort logic without a deploy. also will log prompt template usage per user and prompt -> llm call mapping.
Carlos (content): can marketing own micro-copy A/B? e.g., CTA text "Try with templates" vs "Start building"? small test to see prompt adoption.
Ben (marketing): yes — add A/B for CTA text in email and button label. keep buttons tracked.
Ava (growth): timeline proposal: today — finalize prompts + email copy. tomorrow — infra + routing + analytics. day after — launch to a 4k holdout sample (2k per cohort). run for 7 days, evaluate on day 8.
Zoe (events): i'll schedule the 48h webinar and add a lightweight funnel slide for the kickoff.
Priya (ops): noted. i'll also add an offline alert if webhook fails so SDR team gets an aggregate list every hour.
Ben (marketing): ok folks — action items: Carlos post prompt pack by 3pm, Priya infra + lambda, Eve dashboard skeleton, Zoe webinar RSVP, Ava monitor sample seeding. will sync tomorrow 10am. :thumbsup:
Ava (growth): +1. excited.
Eve (analytics): one more ask — let's capture which prompt templates drive the highest follow-up API calls and length of sessions. we might promote high-engagement templates in onboarding later.
Ben (marketing): great. thanks team. will draft a short launch post for community channels after we have 24h signals. :sparkles:
